name: @pi-hunter/gmp-native
description: Minimal native N-API addon wrapping real (non-WASM) GMP for arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic. Exists because gmp-wasm (standard 32-bit WebAssembly) hits a hard 4GB linear-memory ceiling around ~125M decimal digits  -  see docs/architecture.md §5.1. Native GMP has no such ceiling (bound only by real system memory).
